source_scope: CISI vol. 1/2 introduction conventions plus target OCR/page-label evidence for H-771/H-893/H-925/H-983/H-353
correction_to_previous_gate: Replace blanket extra-side language with a split: bis/ter/quater are same-side photograph variants; A/B/C labels are side categories; object-number forms like H-893 (1) A and H-925 (2) B remain unreconciled.
immediate_research_consequence: H-771 is less physically side-mismatched than first described, but still blocked by photo selection and direction/subtype uncertainty. H-983 and H-353 have genuine C-side hazards. H-893 and H-925 remain blocked by unexplained numbered labels.
